objects.name: Week in review: Cisco fixes IMC bug, Patch Tuesday forecast, Black Hat USA 2026
objects.description: Here’s an overview of some of last week’s most interesting news, articles, interviews and videos: Mapping the malware blast radius a single alert won’t show you In this interview with Help Net Security, Mike Wiacek, founder and CTO of Stairwell, explains Backstory, an AI agent that takes a single alert and works outward to map how far a malware campaign spread.
